overall: POOR on the east side, GOOD on the Coron side: Coron, Galoc, Panlaitan, Maglalambay and Decabobo fish well; Nangalao stays VERY POOR and Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan stay shut through Saturday midday
limiterDetail: The main limiter is a combination , led by east wind (Nangalao 20–23 kt, Cabunlawan/Decabaitot 18.5–22 kt, Ciron 17–22 kt, Barangonan 18–21 kt; Linapacan 12–17 kt), plus current at Decabaitot (1.3–1.7 kt about 9 PM–2 AM), Barangonan and Alava (1.1–1.6 kt tonight), and Tara (1.0–1.1 kt mid-afternoon and again Saturday morning). Rain is minor: 0.1–0.3 mm/h at Barangonan, Linapacan, Maglalambay and Panlaitan about Saturday 3–5 AM / noon, elsewhere dry.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR. No gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA. The feed still lists an older tropical cyclone alert for Typhoon Rosal (Champi) that doesn't name Palawan; worth a glance on the PAGASA site.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: The fishing mix improved to 5 GOOD / 4 MARGINAL / 6 POOR / 1 VERY POOR (was 5 GOOD / 3 MARGINAL / 4 POOR / 4 VERY POOR), but the supply outlook is unchanged. Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan dropped out of VERY POOR as the east wind eased a few knots from this morning's peaks (Nangalao now 20.4 kt gusts 27, was 23.6 g31; Cabunlawan/Decabaitot 18.5 g24, was 22.1 g29; Ciron 16.6 g21, was 21.7 g29). Tara and Turda recovered to MARGINAL; Alava slipped to POOR on 1.1 kt current.

East side still has no usable window through Saturday midday — Nangalao stays at 20–23 kt, Cabunlawan/Decabaitot 18.5–22.3 kt, Ciron 16.6–22.1 kt, Barangonan 17.5–20.7 kt. Fri 6 stays SLIGHTLY SOFT leaning softer; Sat 7 and Sun 8 stay SLIGHTLY SOFT; Mon 9 NORMAL. Tightening risk remains high. PAGASA still shows no warning for Palawan.

supply.note: Monday lighter than this morning (8.6 kt, gusts 14, 1.1 mm). Tuesday 10 kt, gusts 18, dry. Wednesday 9.7 kt with 1.5 mm. Thursday now the week's roughest (12 kt, gusts 17, 1.9 mm). Medium confidence this far out

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF (unchanged). The dashboard's shortage detector stays ELEVATED for Fri–Thu (guide only; it reacts to the 0.6–0.7 kt daily currents). Tightening risk remains high: five soft arrival days in a row (Wed 4 to Sun 8), and the east grounds will have missed about three days by Saturday morning. Lean on the Coron side, Galoc, Panlaitan, Maglalambay and Decabobo for weekend supply.

bestWindow.headline: About now–6 PM at Panlaitan and Maglalambay; about 5 PM–1 AM on the Coron side; rest of today at Decabobo
details: Panlaitan and Maglalambay: 0.7–3.6 kt about now–6 PM, current 0.1–0.3. Coron and Galoc: 3.1–5.1 kt from about 5 PM to 1 AM, current 0.0–0.4. Decabobo: 2–5 kt, current 0.2–0.5 rest of today. Tara and Turda: wind is light, so go about 10 PM–1 AM when the current eases to 0.4–0.6 kt. Alava and Binudac: easiest wind about 10 PM–1 AM (6–8 kt), but current is 1.0–1.5 kt then, so mid-afternoon is the better compromise (9–10 kt, 0.6–0.8 kt current at Binudac). East side: no usable window; the lightest spell is Ciron at 16.6–17.5 kt this afternoon.
Keep small boats off Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan this afternoon, tonight and Saturday morning (up to 23 kt, gusts near 27).
